items.title: AI OS concept - Analytics and Data screens with gradient cards
items.description: Two iPhone screens from the 'AI OS' concept (Slava Komikov, Version 2.0). 'Analytics' shows a pink gradient Weather card with a dotted '32°', Sun/New York and a sunrise-sunset arc (6:14/17:21) over a bottom dial; 'Data' shows a magenta 'Sleep Quality 25' card with media controls beneath. Layered translucent gradient cards are the concept's signature; the same system appears in IMG-0488/0489.

items.title: AI OS concept - Watch widget grid and a pixel clock face
items.description: Two more 'AI OS' screens: 'Watch' presents a grid of saturated gradient widget tiles (Balance, Sleep, Enhance, Skin Damage, Red Light, Hormones) with an Edit bar; the second phone is a full-bleed blurred gradient carrying a large pixel-dot clock '22:30'. The concept explores watch faces and widgets as glowing gradient objects.

items.title: elsewhere. - 'The world can wait.' moon poster
items.description: A dark editorial poster for 'elsewhere.': a small-caps kicker 'A SMALL ESCAPE FROM EVERYTHING', a serif headline 'The world can wait.' (second line italic), and a large ringed moon rendered in soft blue on a starfield. Below, 'You don't have to be anywhere else.' and the 'elsewhere.' wordmark. A calm, anti-urgency brand moment; the moon does all the emotional work.

items.title: AI money agents - dusk gradient with agent orbs
items.description: A dusk-gradient screen greeting 'Hey, Kenan. I've made 12 transactions today.' with a loading spinner. Tabs Agents / Assets / History sit above two circular agent orbs - 'Amra Agent $800.10' and 'Pulse Agent $200.11' - rendered as soft planet-like spheres. The app frames autonomous finance agents as characters you delegate to.

items.title: Event planner - picnic overview with tasks, notes and a budget ring
items.description: A dark group-event screen 'IwuFig Picnic / 2 days left' with tabs Overview / Task / Chat / Memories and 'The Garden, Ikeja Lagos - 7:00 PM'. A 'Tasks' list assigns Buy Drinks, Decorations and Cake Icing to named people with due days; 'Notes' holds arrival reminders; a 'Budget' card shows ₦70,000 of ₦140,000 (50%) with an orange ring. Bottom nav: Home, Create, Notification, Profile. A shared-planning hub in naira.

items.title: Garmenta - choose-your-avatar onboarding step 1 of 3
items.description: A 'Choose Avatar 1/3' onboarding for 'Garmenta': the copy reads 'Choose your Garmenta avatar. Pick one that feels like you. You can change it anytime.' above a 2x3 grid of friendly illustrated avatars, a purple 'Continue' pill and 'Skip for now'. A warm, low-pressure identity step in a gold-edged device frame.

items.title: Illustration community onboarding - bold portrait tiles
items.description: An onboarding screen whose hero is a 2x2 grid of bold illustrated portraits (a crowned singer, a white-haired figure in sunglasses, a dark-skinned portrait on green, a dancer on a red gradient). Below, 'Share Your Creativity With the World / Upload your illustrations and showcase your talent to a global audience' with black 'Get Started' and grey 'Log In'. The artwork grid is both hero and proof of the community.

items.title: Omeit - 'A place to call home' onboarding over a family photo
items.description: A real-estate onboarding for 'Omeit.': a full-bleed photo of a family on a sofa beneath the headline 'A place to call home' and body 'discover spaces designed for comfort, where you and your family can truly feel at home.' A lime 'Get Started' pill and 'Already have an account? Log In' close it. Warm photographic onboarding for a home-finding app.

items.title: Calipa AI - generate 3D icons onboarding
items.description: An onboarding for 'Calipa AI': on a red-to-blue gradient, 'Imagine it. Generate it in 3D. / Turn simple ideas into polished, customizable 3D icons in seconds.' above a glossy 3D orb holding a soft square icon. White 'Create Account' and dark 'Log In' buttons close it. A generator product pitched with its own output as the hero.

items.title: SENDOE - your money in every currency landing
items.description: A landing for 'SENDOE': a lavender globe with floating $ / € / ¥ coin discs and small transfer toasts, under the headline 'Your money, in every currency.' and body 'Hold, send, receive, and manage multiple currencies from one simple, secure account.' White 'Sign Up' and dark 'Log In' buttons close it. A multi-currency money app pitched with a single globe visual.

items.title: Avere - editorial fashion curation feed
items.description: A fashion-commerce feed for 'Avere': 'The New Season Edit' leads with a black 'Quietly Distinct' card (Explore the Collection) beside a hanger photo. 'Find Your Edit' tabs (New Arrivals, Women, Men, Accessories) sit above a product grid - Silk Column Dress $720, Leather Shoulder $760, Cashmere Knit $520 - and 'The Pieces We're Loving'. Editorial curation over hard selling.

items.title: My Listings - Nigerian property management with status chips
items.description: A 'My Listings' screen with filter chips (All, Active, Sold, Inactive). Listing cards show a photo, title and location with a price and status: '3 Plots of Land - Ibeju Lekki, Lagos, ₦12,500,000, Available' with a green Edit button, and '5-Bedroom Duplex - Lekki Phase 1'. Bottom nav: Home, Properties, Payment, Settings. An agent-side property manager in naira.
